Dynamic expressions, loops, forwarded Klippy methods, transports, response schemas, events and optional integrations require independent contract tests. Statuses describe only the cited implementation and contract evidence; partial transport work does not imply full component coverage.

components.name: data_store
components.evidence: Opt-in bounded G-code and temperature histories in gcode-store.ts, temperature-store.ts and temperature-store-runtime.ts, wired through ConfiguredMoonraker. Pinned Python differential, precise decimal rounding, authenticated REST/RPC, sensor discovery, internal aggregate subscriptions, one-second sampling, monitor filtering, reconnect retention and shutdown cancellation tested. Full daemon assembly and production authorization remain incomplete.

components.name: database
components.evidence: Worker-owned SQLite namespace CRUD, upstream scalar/blob format, bounded queue and transactional nested writes in database.ts, database-worker.ts, database-engine.ts and database-record.ts. ConfiguredMoonraker owns optional database lifecycle and authenticated REST/RPC list/item routes. Pinned Python method and bidirectional file tests, capacity rollback, abrupt process termination recovery and disk benchmarks covered. LMDB import, table registration and namespace lifecycle helpers, instance and shutdown bookkeeping, debug endpoints and full daemon remain incomplete; unsafe stored integers reject explicitly. Internal shallow update and literal-root insert/get/delete/move batches now have pinned Python differential tests. Batches use one transaction with at most 64 rows per INSERT statement; later-chunk failure rolls back prior chunks. DATABASE_BATCH_SIZE benchmark includes actual Python thread dispatch; Node remains slower in observed disk round trips. Online backup, atomic published files, deletion and VACUUM/checkpoint now run in FIFO Worker maintenance; REST/RPC creation/compaction require a connected initialized ready printer with observed idle print_stats. Paused/unknown states reject. Admission check does not lease against concurrent print starts. Filesystem-tagged benchmarks distinguish tmpfs from the workspace ext filesystem. Restore now validates integrity/schema/size, copies all tables through SQLite backup, and fences old reads/writes until reopen. Configured restore REST/RPC is registered only with an explicit onDatabaseRestore service owner; response-completion handoff handles cancellation and exposes restart errors. Real local HTTP service recreation is tested; production entry, print-start mutual exclusion, bookkeeping and target hardware remain incomplete.

components.name: klippy_connection
components.evidence: host/src/moonraker/klippy-socket.ts; host/src/moonraker/klippy-lifecycle.ts; host/src/moonraker/subscription-status.ts; ConfiguredMoonraker.attachKlippy; host/test/klippy-lifecycle.test.ts; host/test/subscription-status.test.ts; host/bench/klippy-lifecycle.ts; host/bench/subscription-status.ts. Unix transport, generation-scoped initialization, authorized dynamic forwarding, subscription union/projection model, bounded immutable status cache and serialized multi-client transactions (subscription-manager.ts) wired to KlippyLifecycle, with bounded in-flight delta reconciliation (subscription-journal.ts). WebSocket printer.objects.subscribe now wired with authorized ordered delivery and disconnect cleanup (subscription-delivery.ts). Public agent registration supports bounded pre-start ownership, readiness publication and explicit ConfiguredMoonraker.reconnectKlippy restoration, with no replay of old requests (agent-methods.ts and bench/agent-methods.ts). HTTP query/form connection association now requires explicit source-to-target authorization; Unix/MQTT subscription transports, file-manager path validation, system-service attribution and production daemon remain incomplete. Linux kernel peer credentials are captured once per socket generation using unix-peer.c/unix-peer.ts and retained separately from self-reported info; same-peer upstream helper oracle and cross-process tests cover PID/UID/GID. PID-1 service attribution is not implemented. Explicit superviseKlippy uses one retry owner with default 250ms delay, cancellation and automatic agent restoration (klippy-supervisor.ts; klippy-supervisor.test.ts). Static per-method ApiError failures continue initialization with bounded diagnostics and server.info warnings; connection loss still aborts initialization. Pinned upstream partial-failure loop matches bench/remote-methods.ts. Configured load/start may explicitly enable klippy_uds_address supervision; default /tmp/klippy_uds and literal filesystem path contracts covered by klippy-config.ts, klippy-config.test.ts and bench/klippy-config.ts. Full template renderer, named-user expansion and CLI/service entry remain incomplete.

components.name: mqtt
components.evidence: mqtt-sensors.ts, mqtt-waiters.ts, mqtt-config.ts and mqtt-api.ts: MQTT 3.1/3.1.1/5, TLS, bounded publication, exact-topic temporary subscriptions shared with sensors, and authorized HTTP/WebSocket/Unix publish/subscribe endpoints. ConfiguredMoonraker owns connection and endpoint lifetime. mqtt-macros.ts registers generation-scoped publish_mqtt_topic with instance prefixes, bounded nonblocking jobs and failure metrics. Startup, wire QoS, reconnect, cancellation, precision guards and benchmarks are tested. mqtt-status.ts and mqtt-status-runtime.ts now wire filtered combined/split retained printer status, timed latest-field aggregation, bounded nonblocking batches and Klippy/broker generation fencing; differential and real loopback tests plus bench/mqtt-status.ts cover this path. ConfiguredMoonraker now enables retained online/offline status and CONNECT will on all three protocols, with bounded shutdown and no DISCONNECT after offline acknowledgment failure; mqtt-presence.test.ts and bench/mqtt-presence.ts cover wire and lifecycle behavior. mqtt-rpc.ts now dispatches bounded incoming RPC with explicit broker-domain authorization, retained-command rejection, upstream-compatible 20-timestamp screening, connection cancellation and response handoff; configured-mqtt-rpc.test.ts, mqtt-rpc.test.ts and mqtt-rpc benchmarks cover this candidate path. Production broker/will delivery, complete configuration/template wiring, durable control idempotency and real macro/print acceptance remain incomplete.
